release_notes: Recover endpoint rows that whole-column OCR skips by re-reading padded individual endpoint cells as a clean stacked column
Run the stacked endpoint OCR only after normal pair matching fails, so already-readable rows keep the existing fast path
Require both endpoint numbers to be observed from the PDF and to identify exactly one existing directional master pipe before recovery
Keep valid non-master pairs unresolved for Add/Ignore review and preserve all v93 and earlier safeguards
